comparison.objective: Manipulate a Kerplunk game, presumably removing sticks while managing supported pieces; unlike adjusting and validating a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Likely slender-stick grasping and extraction with disturbance avoidance, versus hex-key seating, collar rotation, counterholding, and torque control. Body and specs are absent.
comparison.success_condition: Title alone suggests game-specific removal without dropping supported pieces, but no exact objective, scoring, loss limits, or thresholds are available. Candidate requires measured no-bottoming, no-hard-stop, rebound, overload, and drift results.
comparison.reason: The game tests extraction and support-disturbance control, not mechanical parameter adjustment and lock verification.
